records.description: A gradient hit counter climbs to '12 HIT COMBO' with rating words like 'PERFECT'.

records.name: combobox
records.title: UI Combobox
records.description: A combobox whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the panel fade/scale/lift are keyframed presets like select. The trigger reuses the Input presets (typed query + caret reveal via an injected inputStyle), the list is filtered by a pure case-insensitive substring on the visible query prefix, and rows reuse the SelectItem row.

records.name: comet-headline
records.title: Comet Headline
records.description: A headline and subhead arrive while a comet streaks arcs behind it, 'Every launch beat, already in orbit.'.

records.name: comic-panels
records.title: Comic Panels
records.description: The frame cracks into a three-panel comic page with speed lines, red halftone and a starburst, then the action panel bursts into a full-frame POW.

records.name: command-menu
records.title: UI Command Menu
records.description: A ⌘K command palette whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the panel zoom + backdrop dim are dialog-like keyframed presets. The search row reveals the typed query, the list is filtered by a pure case-insensitive substring on the visible query prefix, and rows reuse the CommandMenuItem row.

records.name: command-menu-item
records.title: UI Command Menu Item
records.description: A command-palette row whose idle/hover/press/selected state is a pure function of the timeline. Leading icon + label + trailing shortcut kbd. Exports an inline CommandMenuItemRow (reused by CommandMenu) and a standalone CommandMenuItem atom; the row background, label color, and icon color are keyframed presets.

records.name: compact-stat
records.title: Compact Stat
records.description: A big 1.2M with a blue-gradient suffix sits above a small caption on a dark ground.

records.name: concentric-scale
records.title: Concentric Scale
records.description: Concentric dotted discs scale from 1 to 1,000 while 100,000 creators lands beside the glowing last disc.

records.name: confetti
records.title: Confetti
records.description: Deterministic confetti burst for Remotion — seeded particles with gravity, spin, and flutter so every render is identical. Fire it on any frame as a celebratory overlay.

records.name: context-menu
records.title: UI Context Menu
records.description: A right-click context menu whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the panel scales from its top-left corner (the click point) with a fade + lift. No trigger — the caller positions it. Rows reuse the DropdownMenuItem row; items are plain string labels.

records.name: contribution-heatmap
records.title: Contribution Heatmap
records.description: A pixel heatmap fills in under a counter rolling up to 12,480 renders.

records.name: cool-down
records.title: Cool Down
records.description: A short statement, 'Runs cool.', settles in large over a faint grid with a mono caption.

records.name: cooling-type
records.title: Cooling Type
records.description: "What if your launch video could write itself?" cools in, ending on an italic word and a caret.

records.name: core-sum
records.title: Core Sum
records.description: A monospace figure sums up to 2,097,152 beside a divider and a small caption.

records.name: countdown
records.title: Countdown
records.description: A monumental countdown numeral inside a ring resolves into a Live lockup.

records.name: counter-reveal
records.title: Counter Reveal
records.description: A huge front word reveals through the counters of its letters on a blue gradient.

records.name: coupon-apply
records.title: Coupon Apply
records.description: A checkout order summary rejects a coupon, accepts another and the total drops.

records.name: cover-ring
records.title: Cover Ring
records.description: An audio-style bar meter sits above the line "They're composed" over green light.

records.name: coy-denial
records.title: Coy Denial
records.description: A huge "Don't check the site at nine." with a sheepish "(Do.)" tucked into the corner.

records.name: crash-zoom
records.title: Crash Zoom
records.description: A calm serif tease crash-zooms into a huge gradient '1 DAY.' with speed lines.

records.name: crew-of-one
records.title: Crew of One
records.description: A credits roll, Written by / Directed by / Shipped by, all pointing at a big "you".

records.name: crosshair-lock
records.title: Crosshair Lock
records.description: A crosshair locks onto the peak of a dot plot and calls out 2.4k per minute.

records.name: crt-screen
records.title: CRT Screen
records.description: Put a scene behind curved glass: the picture bulges out to the corners, an RGB phosphor mask and scanlines ride the curve, bright areas flood the mask, and the tube falls away into darkness at the rim.

records.name: crumple-toss
records.title: Crumple Toss
records.description: Crushes an element into a ball of paper and throws it out of frame on an arc, leaving the scene around it running.

records.name: crunch
records.title: Crunch
records.description: A timestamped story line, "It shipped, with time to ...", fades in over a dark brown ground.

records.name: cta-collapse-mark
records.title: CTA Collapse Mark
records.description: Call-to-action content collapses into the Remocn wordmark over a glowing planet horizon.

records.name: cue-word
records.title: Cue Word
records.description: A cue word triggers a slide, drop or lift cut to the next line on a pink ground.

records.name: cursor
records.title: UI Cursor
records.description: An animated cursor that moves between waypoints, clicks (ripple), and drags. The Cursor renderer is a pure function of a numeric CursorStyle channel; useCursorPath reads the frame and eases the path, ripple, and press phases.

records.name: cursor-frame
records.title: Cursor Frame
records.description: A selection frame with handles and a size badge is dragged around a two-line headline.

records.name: cursor-gravity
records.title: Cursor Gravity
records.description: A rounded triangular cursor tugs a button out of the screen edge with pulsed elastic resistance.

records.name: cut-off
records.title: Cut Off
records.description: A line is cut off by a white reply card: "Or let the code cut it.".

records.name: cut-stat
records.title: Cut Stat
records.description: A blue bar graph wipes upward beside a big minus 44% caption, 'less time to a finished cut'.

records.name: deadpan-box
records.title: Deadpan Box
records.description: A flat, deadpan quote in a blue box with a small attribution line.

records.name: deploy-pipeline
records.title: Deploy Pipeline
records.description: A deployment page runs a build, streams logs and flips to Ready.

records.name: depth-headline
records.title: Depth Headline
records.description: A huge serif headline sits behind a gradient sphere that slides through it for depth.

records.name: design-audit

records.name: device-grows-around

records.name: device-morph

records.name: diagonal-split
records.title: Diagonal Split
records.description: A diagonal seam slides one scene away to reveal the next with a warm band.

records.name: dialog
records.title: UI Dialog
records.description: A modal dialog whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the backdrop dim and popup zoom are keyframed presets, with a close button and a primary action. Self-contained — pair it with the Button as a trigger (see the example).

records.name: diff-swap
records.title: Diff Swap
records.description: A before line is diffed into the after line, ending 'Install the scene. Edit the props.'.

records.name: diminuendo
records.title: Diminuendo

records.name: disc-pop

records.name: displacement

records.name: distribution-shift

records.name: dither-dissolve
records.title: Dither Dissolve

records.name: dolly-zoom

records.name: domino-run

records.name: dot-field-morph
records.title: Dot Field Morph

records.name: dot-globe
records.title: Dot Globe

records.name: dot-map
records.title: Dot Map
records.description: A dotted world map lights up city by city, ending on 142 countries.

records.name: dot-sort
records.title: Dot Sort

records.name: dot-type

records.name: double-take

records.description: "Read that again." above an oversized pink "One person" on blue.

records.name: drawer
records.title: UI Drawer
records.description: A bottom panel whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the backdrop dim and bottom-edge slide-up are keyframed presets, with a drag handle and a primary action. Self-contained — pair it with the Button as a trigger (see the example).

records.name: drift
records.title: Drift
records.description: A slow linear camera push-in wrapper that scales its scene from 1 to 1+grow across the sequence so no frame is ever static.

records.name: drop-timer
records.title: Drop Timer

records.name: drop-upload
records.title: Drop Upload

records.name: dropdown-menu
records.title: UI Dropdown Menu
records.description: A dropdown menu whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the trigger reuses the Button primitive and the reveal panel composes DropdownMenuItem rows. The panel fade, scale, lift, and chevron are keyframed presets.

records.name: dropdown-menu-item
records.title: UI Dropdown Menu Item

records.name: duet-split

records.name: dumbbell-shift

records.name: duotone-beat

records.name: dynamic-letter

records.name: echo-stack

records.name: ecosystem-constellation

records.name: agent-steps
records.title: Agent Steps
records.description: AI agent steps animation: a streaming task log with spinner and checkmarks for agent demos. An agent narrating its own work: the prompt lands in a pill, and under it a log writes itself one line at a time — each step running with a faint spinning globe, then flipping to past tense behind a check while the whole column steps up a row so the live line always sits on the centre. When the work is done the column swells and clears, and the last line slides to the middle and becomes the answer. Every proportion and every curve is fitted from frame measurements.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/ai-input/agent-steps?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

records.name: announce-title
records.title: Announce Title
records.description: Launch title animation, product announcement intro with kinetic typography. A four-shot launch title: the eyebrow rushes past the camera on a receding type plane and lands on a colour field, the name assembles word by word on paper, and a macro pan across the tagline cuts wide as the line builds itself last word first while a white sweep drains it out of colour. Content, palette and the mark that leads the closing line are all props.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/announce-title?ref=cli — its colours are explicit props (`paperColor`, `titleColor`, `voidColor`, …) rather than a palette, and it takes no `mode`.

records.name: answer-highlight
records.title: Answer Highlight
records.description: AI answer highlight animation, ChatGPT-style chat response with a text selection. A question in a pill, an answer that writes itself a word at a time, and then the beat the whole shot is for: a caret lands mid-sentence and a selection band drags across one statement, wrapping the line the way a real one does — and settles onto the single word that matters. Name the sentence and the word as strings; the run is found in the answer for you, punctuation and all.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/ai-input/answer-highlight?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

records.name: answer-stream

Every word arrives hot and cools to the foreground.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/ai-input/answer-stream?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

records.name: bloom-lockup
records.title: Bloom Lockup

records.name: button-press
records.title: Button Press

records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/cursor/button-press?ref=cli — label, pending and done are the three states; width is fixed so the button never reflows. Pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette.

records.name: capture-reveal
records.title: Capture Reveal
records.description: Screenshot capture animation: a toast counts "Capturing selection…" up to 100% over a browser window, the window drops away and shrinks, the toast pops to "Copied to clipboard." and a two-line headline rises out from behind the window while the cursor glides up. Every curve was measured off a recording frame by frame: the window's drop and shrink share one cubic-bezier, the toast pops on another, the headline rises without scaling or blurring, and type moves by fractions of a pixel.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/screens/capture-reveal?ref=cli — src is the screenshot in the window (laid in at full width, top first); headline breaks lines on |; capturing and copied are the two toast messages. Pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette.

records.name: card-rail
records.title: Card Rail
records.description: Card carousel animation: cards flicked sideways on a tilted 3D plane. A rail of cards flicked sideways across a tilted plane. The cards do not crawl past on a loop — they are flicked: the rail leaves at speed, decelerates for well over a second and comes to rest about a card further along, the way a carousel behaves under a thumb rather than under a timer. The plane is not flat to the camera either. Measured on a recording's card edges, the horizontal scale grows 0.000825 per pixel of height about the frame's own centre line, so the foot of a card is a fifth wider than its head while horizontals stay horizontal and the type stays upright — which is why a row of plain rectangles reads as a surface receding into the frame rather than as a filmstrip.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/card-rail?ref=cli — images, titles, notes and tags are parallel lists split by `|` (not by comma: a data: URL has one of its own), one entry per card, and the rail repeats them rather than running out. Leave the text fields blank and the picture becomes the whole card, which is how a card designed elsewhere is handed in as one image. heading holds the top of the frame; from is the frame the flick starts on and may be negative to open mid-flight; offset is where the rail sits before it moves. backdrop takes two colour stops or one picture. Pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette.

records.name: channel-thread
records.title: Channel Thread
records.description: Slack-style chat animation: team messages arrive with typing dots. A work chat filling itself in, the way the channel actually reads: an avatar, a name in bold, a quiet timestamp and the messages as plain lines under them. Messages land one at a time, a second message from the same person joins the group without repeating the name, and when somebody new starts typing three dots hold their line until the words arrive. The transcript never creeps — it sits perfectly still between arrivals and then scrolls, once, by exactly the room the new line needs, and only when the newest line would fall past the anchor. Every vertical number came off a recording and closes on it: carry the layout's arithmetic across the whole scene and it predicts the last frame's baselines to within a pixel.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/channel-thread?ref=cli — script is the conversation, groups split by `;` and a group's messages by `|`; people is one `name time` per group; beats is the frame each message lands on and opens is the frame its row appears, so a pause before someone answers is a number rather than a gap you have to guess at. avatars takes one image per group, split by `|` (not by comma — a data: URL has one of its own). Pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette.

records.name: check-cycle
records.title: Check Cycle
records.description: Rotating words beside a checkbox: a sentence that finishes itself several ways. "Create your own" sits left of a ticked shadcn-style checkbox and the word to its right rolls up out of a slot — Intros, Demos, Launches, Changelogs, Tutorials, And more — then the line steps back a little and rests. Every number came off a recording, frame by frame: the two words in the slot move as one strip on the in-out cubic over exactly half a second, a roll every twenty frames. The type moves by fractions of a pixel instead of the whole-pixel steps a browser snaps text to.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/check-cycle?ref=cli — headline is the part of the sentence that never changes; words is what finishes it, comma separated, rolled through in order beside a ticked checkbox, then the line steps back to 80% and rests. Pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette.

records.name: click-type
records.title: Click Type
records.description: Click to type: a prompt composer (Prompt Send's glass panel, writing surface and round send button) whose placeholder writes itself while a cursor flies in from the edge and clicks the field, then a hard cut into the field where the real prompt types at the caret and send arms. Two shots of one composer under a constant camera, anchored on the first letter, so the type never scales while it moves. Built on cursor-track.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/cursor/click-type?ref=cli — placeholder writes itself in the wide shot; prompt is what types after the click, in the close-up. Pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette.

records.name: count-grid
records.title: Count Grid
records.description: Number count-up grid: cards multiply and a counter jumps, the it-scales stat shot. A grid of cards rushes in under a horizontal smear, settles on five and a label, then the camera pulls back a fraction while every empty cell around them fills in from the middle out and the number jumps. The "and it scales" shot, without a cut — one card is deliberately late to land, which is what makes the entry read as five separate things arriving rather than one picture being pushed in.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/count-grid?ref=cli — pass cards an array of image URLs and from/to/noun for the label.

records.name: cursor-track
records.title: Cursor Track
records.description: Cursor click animation: a mouse pointer that moves and clicks over any UI. A synthetic cursor that walks a path of normalized waypoints over any children and pulses a click ring on arrival. A hand-drawn macOS-style arrow with an outline that keeps it readable over arbitrary footage, or a touch puck — for UI sims, and for recordings whose real cursor never made it into the file.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/screens/cursor-track?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

records.name: cut-lockup
records.title: Cut Lockup
records.description: Logo reveal in hard cuts. The logo lands huge on grid paper, steps down in three cuts, pushes in, cuts to night where its construction lines and anchor points draw themselves, then a paper panel wipes up onto the resting lockup. Cuts, scales, push and wipe are measured frame by frame off a reference recording.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/cut-lockup?ref=cli — 108 frames at 30fps; paints its own background. Pass your logo as SVG paths (logo={{ width, height, shapes }}).

records.name: dot-bloom
records.title: Dot Bloom
records.description: Halftone dot transition. White dots spark over the outgoing shot while it washes out to cream, then the cream breaks into warm coral, peach and blush dots in drifting diagonal bands that thin out cell by cell until the incoming shot is all that is left. Every cell of every step is replayed from a reference recording.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/transitions/dot-bloom?ref=cli — lay it over both shots and cut under it at DOT_BLOOM_CUT, where the cream covers the frame.

records.name: drop-line
records.title: Drop Line
records.description: Words cut past one card at a time, then the last word sinks out from under the dot of its own i
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/drop-line?ref=cli — 38 frames at 30fps.

records.name: follower-rush
records.title: Follower Rush
records.description: Follower count animation: X/Twitter follower notification with a count-up and avatar wave, for social proof. An X-style follower notification that piles up — avatars stack in and the count explodes, then the row bends into an undulating wave of faces.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/social/follower-rush?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

records.name: font-shuffle
records.title: Font Shuffle
records.description: Launch title animation: the line decodes out of scrambled glyphs set in the wrong typeface, flashes the accent, settles to ink, then the product name cycles through eleven typefaces (mono, light, humanist, pixel, script, slab, condensed, italic, blackletter, wide, bold grotesk) while the line zooms a step closer on each swap. Every beat is a held state measured off a recording frame by frame — timing, masks, layout, zoom and colour.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/font-shuffle?ref=cli — lead stays serif, subject tries on eleven typefaces; accent is the colour the line flashes before it settles. Pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette.

records.name: gather-lockup
records.title: Gather Lockup
records.description: Logo reveal in two and a half seconds. A wall of your work sits under a line of type. The line falls apart word by word, the wall cuts in to a row of four, and each slot swaps its picture and hands over to your mark and wordmark. Measured frame by frame off a reference recording.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/gather-lockup?ref=cli — 60 frames at 24fps; paints its own background. Pass 15 images, and your logo as SVG paths (logo={{ width, height, shapes }}).

records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/hello-zoom?ref=cli — 75 frames at 30fps.

records.name: logo-assemble
records.title: Logo Assemble
records.description: Logo reveal animation: image cards orbit and collapse into your logo and brand name. A single ring of image cards revolves around a centred title, then spins inward and drains to the middle — giving birth to a simple logo that slides left as the brand name reveals to its right.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/logos/logo-assemble?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

records.name: logo-collapse
records.title: Logo Collapse
records.description: Logo reveal intro: a stack of photos flicks through and collapses into your logo. A stack of shots flicked through, collapsing into your mark, and the wordmark landing beside it. One card holds the middle of the frame and cuts to the next shot, each smaller and each held for less time than the last, so the sequence winds itself up instead of running at a constant clip. Nothing cross-fades and nothing tweens between shots — the reference holds each card at a fixed size for its whole beat and then cuts, which reads as a stack of prints being dealt rather than as a zoom. At the end of the run the card cuts to a plain tile with the mark on it, the mark overshoots its resting size by a third and settles in three frames, the tile goes, and the mark steps aside twice to make room for the word.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/logos/logo-collapse?ref=cli — images is the stack, split by `|` (not by comma: a data: URL has one of its own); sizes and holds are parallel to it, one entry per shot, sizes as a share of the frame height where `0.48` is square and `0.82x0.461` is 16:9; mark is what the stack collapses into and wordmark the word that lands beside it. background takes an optional plate and accent the colour the two brackets ping in. Pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette.

records.name: logo-drift
records.title: Logo Drift
records.description: Logo wall animation: a logo cloud of integrations drifting behind a headline. A field of tiles drifting past a headline while the camera pulls steadily back, so the wall of things-it-works-with keeps arriving from every edge. The pull-back is one linear scale measured at 0.176 per second across every tile; the words do not fade in, they arrive 1.216× large and 4.3px soft and land in 140ms.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/logos/logo-drift?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

records.name: logo-flicker
records.title: Logo Flicker
records.description: Logo reveal intro: a fast image flicker that settles on your logo. Images flip across a central card very fast, the flicker decelerates and fades, and the logo and brand name resolve underneath — a strobe of imagery settling onto the mark.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/logos/logo-flicker?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

records.name: moodboard-reveal
records.title: Moodboard Reveal
records.description: Photo gallery reveal: a moodboard fly-through that lands on a hero image. A kinetic headline with a swapping inline image, then a scattered gallery of photos flies in, the camera pushes through it as the background lifts from near-black to off-white, and it lands on a single hero image.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/moodboard-reveal?ref=cli — this scene spans light and dark by design, so it takes no `mode` — pass `theme` to repaint it.

records.name: orb-swarm
records.title: Orb Swarm
records.description: Kinetic typography scene with glass orbs: a sentence told one beat at a time while four orbs burst out of it, split into eight and sixteen, wind into a clockwise vortex, collapse into a knot, pay out as a chain, loop around the closing words and shrink away bead by bead. Every phase was measured frame by frame off a 24fps reference and is replayed on the same clock; the orbs are shaded per pixel into a canvas (a scrolling band texture bowed like latitude lines, a soft glass edge) and the type is drawn into the same canvas four times finer than the frame so its baselines land between pixels.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/orb-swarm?ref=cli — script is six cards separated by |; the first, second and last arrive whole and the three in the middle reveal word by word. softness is the blur on the type in card pixels (0 is crisp). background and ink are the page and the settled type; orbColor recolours the orbs (and the word tints) by hue, keeping their shading.

records.name: orbit-gallery
records.title: Orbit Gallery
records.description: Image gallery intro: photos spiral into the centre around a title. An image-universe hero: a continuous stream of photos flows along an Archimedean spiral (a vortex) from the frame edges into the center — evenly spaced by arc length, shrinking and rotating to follow the coil, with the title held in the clear middle. A slow, cinematic opener for launch and editorial videos.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/orbit-gallery?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

records.name: phone-frame
records.title: Phone Frame
records.description: iPhone mockup animation: phone device frame for app screenshots and screen recordings. iPhone-style device frame with a dynamic island and a screen slot — flat or lightly 3D-tilted, with rise, rotate-in, or float entrances and a subtle float loop.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/screens/phone-frame?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

records.name: phone-stack
records.title: Phone Stack
records.description: Stacked phone screens with video. Phone screens rise out of a blur from below one after another, and each new one pushes the stack back: the older screens shrink and step up so only their tops peek out above the newest. Every screen plays its own clip under an iOS status bar. Proportions measured off a reference recording.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/screens/phone-stack?ref=cli — pass one clip per screen as videos; the page and glow are props.

records.name: portal-intro
records.title: Portal Intro
records.description: Sentence-to-picture intro. The lead words fade up one at a time, the line re-sets with a small rounded picture chip inside it and leans in until the chip takes the frame; a title types itself over the picture, lifts away, and the mark and the name arrive. Fitted frame by frame from a reference recording.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/portal-intro?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame; the picture, title and mark are props.

records.name: prompt-send
records.title: Prompt Send
records.description: AI prompt typing animation: a chat input types a prompt and a cursor clicks send. A composer that unrolls from a hairline, writes a brief into itself while the camera cuts in and rides the caret, then cuts back out to the send button as a pointer arrives and clicks it. The typing is eased, not constant — 17 chars/sec on the first word, 33 in the middle, a settle on the last three. Long copy scrolls the field under its own caret and extra suggestions wrap, so the panel fits whatever you put in it.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/ai-input/prompt-send?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

records.name: prompt-zoom
records.title: Prompt Zoom
records.description: AI prompt zoom: an assistant home screen that cuts into the chat input as the prompt types. An assistant landing screen that offers its suggestions, then cuts — hard, in a single frame — into the caret, where the prompt types itself. The push-in is a measured 2.547× anchored on the text insertion point, not an animated zoom.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/ai-input/prompt-zoom?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

records.name: pulsing-border
records.title: Pulsing Border
records.description: AI glow border: a pulsing thinking frame around the screen. Glowing 'AI is working' frame — a soft pulsing border overlay that breathes around the scene edges while a response streams.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs?ref=cli — pulsing-border draws with WebGL, and Remotion's headless Chromium has no GL context by default — render it with `npx remotion render --gl=angle` (or set `Config.setChromiumOpenGlRenderer("angle")`), or the render fails with 'WebGL is not supported in this browser'.

records.name: punch-lines
records.title: Punch Lines
records.description: Kinetic typography title cards: bold statements that cut hard between beats. A run of full-frame title cards that cut hard between beats. A statement card is flicked in from the left line by line and settles on a critically damped curve, then rushes past the camera; a hero card punches its words up from a third of their size in a wave and pushes slowly forward until it cuts. Every curve is fitted from frame measurements — the slide to 0.42px rms over 37 frames.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/punch-lines?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

records.name: reel-collage
records.title: Reel Collage
records.description: Photo reel that shuts into a collage. A picture cuts through a quick reel between two captions and slowly zooms, then shuts like an eyelid while the captions fold into one stacked line; the copy swaps, the lines split, and a scattered collage blooms in around them on a peach flush. Every curve is fitted from a reference recording, frame by frame.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/reel-collage?ref=cli — the page, glow and flush are props; the captions take the theme's foreground.

records.name: reel-wall
records.title: Reel Wall
records.description: Curved video wall for Remotion. A ring of vertical clips turns past in the dark: it eases in from rest on twos, then keeps turning at an even speed. The ring, lens and ease are fitted frame by frame from a reference recording.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/reel-wall?ref=cli — pass your own vertical clips as videos; they repeat around the ring.

records.name: roster-grant
records.title: Roster Grant
records.description: Access granted animation: a cursor clicks a CTA and team avatars switch on. Three rows of roster cards stream past a call to action, a pointer walks in and clicks it, and the monograms start turning to the accent one every seven frames — top row, middle, bottom, top, bottom, middle, so it reads as a system granting rather than a list iterating. The camera and the middle row's clearance around the pill settle on the same measured exponential; the outer rows deliberately do not, which is what stops the two sides ever looking symmetric.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/roster-grant?ref=cli — pass rows as three arrays of { name, role } and label for the button.

records.name: screen-recording
records.title: Screen Recording
records.description: Screen recording zoom: crop and auto-zoom a product demo capture. The treatment that turns a raw screen capture into a shot: crop the browser and OS chrome off each edge as a fraction, fit what is left to the frame, and run a keyframed camera that pushes in on whatever matters at a given frame and holds until the next move. Takes a video or a still through the same track.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/screens/screen-recording?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

records.name: search-typing
records.title: Search Typing
records.description: Search bar typing animation for AI search and command palette demos. A search field wider than the shot: two thirds in frame, then it comes forward, types across its left half, pages to its right half, and goes back. Every proportion is measured, and the scale pivots on the text baseline so the type never climbs the pixel grid.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/ai-input/search-typing?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/sky-lockup?ref=cli — 57 frames at 30fps; paints its own background. Pass your logo as SVG paths (logo={{ width, height, shapes }}).

records.title: Text Rewrite

records.name: word-flip
records.title: Word Flip
records.description: Word flip text rotator: a typewriter headline with a 3D rotating word. A headline types itself out, then one word cycles on a 3D flip — it sinks into an anticipation dip, throws up and away about its baseline under motion blur, and the next word unfurls from below. The slot is reserved from the first keystroke, so nothing in the sentence ever reflows.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/word-flip?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.

records.name: word-gather
records.title: Word Gather
records.description: Word-by-word sentence animation: words fly in out of order and settle into the line. A sentence that arrives one word at a time, out of order, and gathers. The first word holds the middle of the frame on its own; then the rest drop in around it — not in reading order and not where they belong — each landing near its slot in the accent colour and sliding the last of the way home, turning to ink as it settles. The line makes room for them as they come, and when the last one is down the whole block eases back to its real size. The layout is solved here rather than left to the browser, because a word has to be transformed from somewhere else to its slot and knowing where its slot is means having laid the line out yourself — which also means the line break cannot move while the block's scale is changing under it.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/word-gather?ref=cli — text is the sentence and its first word is the one that holds the frame alone; maxWidth is where the line breaks, in card pixels; accent is the colour a word wears while it is still travelling. Pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette.

records.name: word-wheel
records.title: Word Wheel
records.description: Rotating words text: a slot machine word wheel that spins and stops on one word. A column of words that spins like a reel and stops on one of them. A fixed lead-in holds the left of the line and the word that finishes the sentence lives in a slot beside it — one row of a taller column whose other words are visible above and below, smaller and grey, fading out toward the top and bottom of the frame. The reel rolls, decelerates over a second and three quarters and comes to rest with one word at full size and in ink. Every number in it was recovered frame by frame from a recording: the 34px row pitch that every baseline including the oversized one sits on, the 1.665x the selected word grows by, and the deceleration itself — which ships as a measured table rather than a curve, because the closest cubic-bezier is five pixels out at its worst and a fifth of a row is a visibly different frame.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/word-wheel?ref=cli — headline is the part of the line that never changes; words is the reel, comma separated, and its FIRST entry is the one the scene comes to rest on; spin is how many rows the reel travels, and left at the list's own length it turns exactly once and comes home. Pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette.

records.name: wordmark-cut
records.title: Wordmark Cut
records.description: Wordmark reveal end card: a huge brand name with a hard cut to a close-up. A wordmark twice the width of the frame, cooling from a lit gradient to ink while it settles, and then a hard cut onto its last letters and the dot — 1.71× nearer, with a shallow depth of field the wide shot does not have, which is the only thing that says the second shot is closer rather than just bigger. It holds a beat and pushes in, still accelerating on the last frame.
records.use: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/wordmark-cut?ref=cli — pass word for the wordmark and dotFrom/dotTo for the gradient.
